## Change

What changes, why, and which issue does this address?

## Verification

List commands and results. For visual changes, include sanitized screenshots,
tested viewports/themes/layouts and any limitations.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/timschps/architecture-presenter/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and kept the change focused.
- [ ] Changed behavior has focused regression coverage; affected docs are updated.
- [ ] Python and browser checks pass (or I explained a local limitation; CI is still required).
- [ ] No secrets, private designs/decks, session data or personal generated output are included.
- [ ] Offline behavior, truth labels, fixed geometry and existing snapshots are preserved.
- [ ] Dependencies/workflow changes are justified; action pins and lockfiles are current.

## Compatibility and risks

Describe contract, design-lock or migration impact. Say "none" if not applicable.
